correctness.rationale: Legal balanced endpoint suffixes are exactly the reversed prefixes completing a positive initial and negative final primitive excursion; direct mex induction yields negative-run counting, not merely return counting. A unique signed-excursion/meander grammar yields the stated algebraic series. The even/odd doubling follows from even-length excursions, the sharp maximum from a four-letter cost per negative run, and factorial moments plus conditional iid excursion signs prove the half-atomic half-normal limit. Two independent finite checkers agree on all 32,767 positions through length 14, and independently on the first 51 length distributions.

value.rationale: This natural endpoint restriction changes a return-counting game into a nontrivial run-mex game. The theorem resolves the exact Grundy value at every binary position and the full two-variable length-by-nimber distribution; its sharp four-letter threshold and parity-doubling property are structural, and the diffuse half-normal/atomic-zero mixture is a meaningful phase contrast with the unrestricted balanced game. It is a motivated complete classification, not an arbitrary small finite check.
